class.name: ARCoreInterface
class.brief_description: Advanced Android ARCore backend owned by ARView.
class.description: Available only on Android arm64/API 29+ with Mobile/Vulkan and an ARCore-supported device. Access through ARView.interface; shared scripts should use ClassDB or dynamic calls because this class is absent on desktop/iOS. All session calls belong on the main thread in Safe rendering mode. ARView owns initialization, lifecycle and presentation. Camera-config/path setters are advanced user controls; changing them can reset the session and invalidate old identities. Diagnostics, native queries, datasets and harness controls are outside the stable game API. Stock Godot 4.7.2 uses CPU uploads; engines providing ExternalTexture.submit_hardware_buffer are detected automatically. Do not open CameraServer feeds during an AR session.

method.name: application_pause
method.description: Internal lifecycle protocol used by ARView/platform callbacks and test drivers. Prefer normal application lifecycle for a running view.

method.name: application_resume
method.description: Internal lifecycle protocol used by ARView/platform callbacks and test drivers. Prefer normal application lifecycle for a running view.

method.name: clear_debug_plane
method.description: Internal debug/editor-only harness control. Requests removal of the injected plane.

method.name: create_anchor
method.description: Internal ARView protocol. Creates a world anchor at a finite rigid pose in metres; returns null with a reason warning on failure. Prefer ARView.create_anchor. See [ARAnchorTracker] for lifecycle and ownership.

method.name: create_anchor_from_hit
method.description: Internal ARView protocol. Requires a fresh presented hit. Attaches to the hit's native plane or its subsuming replacement. Prefer ARView.create_anchor_from_hit.

method.name: get_current_packet
method.description: Internal ARView protocol. Returns the latest acquired packet, or null before acquisition/after clearing. This is not necessarily the presented frame.

method.name: get_dataset_diagnostics
method.description: Advanced platform-specific recording/playback status and counters, including completion/errors. No stable dictionary schema is promised.

method.name: get_diagnostics
method.description: Advanced diagnostics dictionary with counters, configuration and collected samples. [code]anchor_count[/code] counts owned game anchors. Keys are platform-specific and outside the stable game API.

method.name: get_plane_finding_mode
method.description: Returns the selected [enum PocketAR.PlaneFindingMode].

method.name: get_playback_inputs
method.description: Drains recorded custom-input dictionaries for application replay; [code][][/code] when none remain. Each recorded frame is delivered once even when ARCore repeats its track data.

method.name: get_presented_packet
method.description: Internal ARView protocol. Returns the last packet marked after draw, or null before presentation/after clearing. A retained native texture is not an image archive.

method.name: get_session_generation
method.description: Returns the current process-wide unique session identity. Old plane and query identities cannot be reused after reset.

method.name: get_session_state
method.description: Returns the current [enum PocketAR.SessionState]. ARView.session_state is the game facade; notifications are deferred.

method.name: get_tracking_reason
method.description: Returns the current [enum PocketAR.TrackingReason]. NONE alone does not guarantee tracking.

method.name: live_hit_test
method.description: Advanced current-native-frame query in view-local pixels. Returns [code][][/code] when unavailable or without a hit. Query IDs expire at the next native update. Results are platform-specific dictionaries, not copied [ARRaycastHit] placement results; prefer ARView.raycast for input.

method.name: live_hit_test_ray
method.description: Advanced current-native-frame query from a finite world origin in metres and a nonzero world direction. Returns [code][][/code] when unavailable or without hits. Query IDs expire on the next native update; results are platform-specific dictionaries.

method.name: mark_applied
method.description: Internal ARView protocol. Protects the packet still used by the camera material, or clears that protection with null. Applies its private anchor snapshots before packet_applied; invalidated samples cannot restore tracking. Do not call on a view-owned interface.

method.name: mark_presented
method.description: Internal ARView protocol, called after draw to advance presentation. Do not call on a view-owned interface.

method.name: owns_anchor
method.description: Internal ARView protocol. Returns whether this interface currently owns the exact tracker object. Stopped and foreign trackers return false.

method.name: record_input
method.description: Records opaque application-owned input bytes on the fixed version-1 track. Maximum 65536 bytes, 128 queued inputs, at most eight new-frame retries for ILLEGAL_STATE. Returns a platform status dictionary.

method.name: remove_anchor
method.description: Internal ARView protocol. Stops and unregisters an owned anchor and releases native ownership. Idempotent for an already stopped tracker from this owner. Does not free game nodes.

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears presentation and planes and changes session generation. Retains the selected plane-finding mode. Prefer ARView.reset for a running view.

method.name: set_camera_config_index
method.description: Advanced camera selection. Use a configuration index listed in get_diagnostics(), or -1 for automatic selection. Changing it resets an active session and changes generation.

method.name: set_camera_path
method.description: Advanced path selection: auto (default) tries supported hardware-buffer submission and otherwise uses CPU; cpu forces CPU uploads. Changing the value resets an active session. GPU presentation starts only after the first successful completion.

method.name: set_debug_plane
method.description: Internal debug/editor-only harness control. Injects a plane at a world transform with full X/Z extents in metres and returns its ID. Not native plane discovery.

method.name: set_diagnostics_enabled
method.description: Advanced diagnostics, false by default. Enables projection/pose/UV checks and image/plane samples. Disabling preserves accumulated samples; error guards and path counters remain active. Timing percentiles cover the latest 512 observations per series. GPU readback has a separate opt-in.

method.name: set_display_geometry
method.description: Internal ARView protocol. Sets viewport pixels, quarter-turn orientation and near/far distances in metres. Native orientation is read from the device. Do not call on a view-owned interface.

method.name: set_gpu_validation_enabled
method.description: Internal validation opt-in for CPU comparison/readback of the GPU camera path. Default false; readback adds stalls and is unsuitable for throughput measurements.

method.name: set_plane_finding_mode
method.description: Defaults to disabled. Selects [enum PocketAR.PlaneFindingMode] before or during the session, retained across pause/reset. Disabling retains existing planes; native refinement behavior differs by platform. Prefer ARView.plane_finding_mode.

method.name: set_point_cloud_enabled
method.description: Advanced diagnostic acquisition, false by default. Copies and releases native point-cloud data in the same tick. There is no public point-cloud getter; reprojection sampling also requires diagnostics enabled.

method.name: start_playback
method.description: Starts Android dataset playback from a private file:// URI in a fresh session generation. Returns void; inspect session state and get_dataset_diagnostics() for errors/end. Restarting the same URI starts another fresh session.

method.name: start_recording
method.description: Advanced Android dataset recording to a percent-encoded file:// URI in private external storage, obtained through PocketARPlugin.getExternalFilesDir(). Returns a platform status dictionary. Recording stops on pause; datasets contain room video and device information.

method.name: stop_recording
method.description: Stops Android dataset recording and returns a platform status dictionary.

method.name: set_suspended
method.description: Internal ARView protocol. Explicit suspension is independent of application pause. Prefer ARView.suspended.

method.name: set_camera_quality
method.description: Prefer ARView.camera_quality. Defaults to HIGHEST; diagnostics report the chosen format.

signal.name: anchors_changed
signal.description: Deferred membership notification forwarded by ARView. Pose changes use inherited tracker signals and ARView.packet_applied.

signal.name: planes_changed
signal.description: Deferred notification that the current plane snapshot/tracker set changed. This is not a presentation notification.

signal.name: session_generation_changed
signal.description: Deferred notification that the session identity changed. Discard old plane/query identities and clear or rebuild placements.

signal.name: session_state_changed
signal.description: Current [enum PocketAR.SessionState] notification, deferred until the native operation finishes. Emitted on changes and initial startup where applicable; handlers may reset safely.

signal.name: tracking_reason_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the current [enum PocketAR.TrackingReason] changes, deferred until the native operation finishes.
